My daughter shared this article with me. Someone with $100M of excess cash just donated it to the Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation.  My daughter,  who is a grant writer for Princess Margaret and a cancer survivor, mentioned that there was quite the celebration amongst staff when this was officially announced. 

#Healthcare #Research #FuckCancer
